panels_ab: Matched Full and No-LR-prior retraining. Projection repeats averaged before paired target-space ratios.
panels_cd: Same-checkpoint interaction-on/off inference. Average projections within each arm and seed, form off/on ratios, then average the three seeds.
training_input: All measured stages in both experiments. Reconstruction, not leave-one-time-point-out prediction.
growth: Continuous unnormalized particle weights, without resampling.
intervention: Entire interaction-network output set to zero. Intrinsic-drift, growth and score networks unchanged.
no_lr_source: no_lr_paired_target_deltas.csv from the matched Full/No-LR-prior comparison, including the retrained ARISTA and chicken-heart models.
